title: Slipway front matter: home layout
description: The landing page in one of four variants: an editorial hero with the latest posts (the default), a landing page with features and a call to action, a blog index, or a docs index.

cta_text.description: Label of the call-to-action button. Shown only with `cta_url`.

features.description: Feature cards for the `landing` variant, in order.

text.description: One or two plain sentences under the heading.

posts_limit.description: How many posts the `editorial` and `blog` variants list. Defaults to 5 for `editorial` and every post for `blog`.

variant.description: How the home page is laid out. `editorial`: a large hero, the body, then the latest posts. `landing`: the hero, the body, the `features` grid, and the call to action again. `blog`: a compact heading, the body, then every post. `docs`: the hero, the body, then the `docs` list of `_data/navigation.yml` as cards.
